messages:
maria (partnerships): Morning team — launching the SI co-sell + HW partner pilot next week. Need a compact rules-of-engagement doc we can share with partners so handoffs aren’t leaky. Quick ideas?

jake (sales): We need a single source of truth for who "owns" the lead. Proposal: 18h claim window from intake notification. If no claim -> partnerships auto-reclaims.

sunil (solutions): 18h is tight but ok for faster cycles. Add an immediate-exception: if ARR >= $300k OR opportunity stage >= Negotiation -> AE auto-claim.

maria (partnerships): Addendum: For hardware-backed deals where partner provides proof-of-concept hardware, require partner PM to register the device SKU on intake; that triggers compliance checks.

amal (hw-partner): We can add SKU metadata. Also need a simple NDA checkbox for any joint announcement assets. If NDA not accepted, block co-branded marketing.

olga (pm): Product constraints: SFDC must get tags: si_owner, si_claim_ts, partner_sku, announcement_ndasigned. We should surface a compact timeline on the intake card: claim_due_ts, tech_sync_due_ts, legal_due_ts.

nina (legal): Legal review window: 2 business days for standard co-brand copy; add 3 business days if HW export/compliance flagged. NDA acceptance is a gating boolean — automate the block if false.

sunil (solutions): Tie-breaker for contested leads: 1) active AE engagement in last 21 days (>=2 logged interactions) wins; 2) else partner who initiated first tech demo wins; 3) if still tied, partnerships-ops mediates with 12h SLA.

jake (sales): What about attribution for co-sell credit? We need simple rules for pipeline credit and partner margin splits so compensation isn't disputed later.

maria (partnerships): Keep it simple for pilot: primary owner gets 70% attribution, partner gets 30% when partner leads come via vendor referral. If AE sourced, AE gets 80/20. We'll refine after pilot.

olga (pm): Implementation notes for intake system: state machine: NEW -> PENDING_CLAIM -> CLAIMED -> TECH_SYNC -> PM_REG-> LEGAL_REVIEW -> ANNOUNCE_READY. Expose current owner and timers.

amal (hw-partner): For announcements, vendor marketing lead must upload final logo and approved blurb to the intake card. No uploads = delay.

nina (legal): Also flag any export-control countries on account. If account HQ in flagged list -> escalate to compliance and add extra 3 business days.

ops-bot: Reminder set: SI co-sell weekly ops at Thursdays 09:30 PT; pilot retro in 3 weeks.

maria (partnerships): Action items: 1) eng: add SFDC tags + claim timers (sunil), 2) product: intake card state + uploads + timers (olga), 3) legal: automate NDA/expflag gating (nina), 4) partnerships: draft partner-facing 1-pager and credit rules (maria). I'll post the 1-pager by EOD. Starting pilot Monday unless objections. :white_check_mark:
